title: ASCEND: choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Routed Hangboard. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Routed Hangboard
options.thesis: The app is the board you train on: grades are routed pockets you press into, numbers are laser-etched.
options.viewport: Log screen is one board: a big routed grade rail, etched session clock, Start as the deepest pocket.
options.risk: Can tip into wood-texture kitsch; grain must stay flat tone, never a photo.

options.label: Orienteering Map
options.thesis: A session is a course: each send is a punched control on the purple line.
options.case: Fuses well: grades as control circles, today's session as the purple leg; outdoor feel, a step away from gym life.

options.label: Boarding Pass + Gate Board
options.thesis: Each session is a pass with segments; history is a board that reranks in place.
options.case: Very clear and fast to read; weak climbing identity, could be any tracker.

options.label: Emission Line Rail
options.thesis: Everything hangs off one rail; grades are thin bright lines, state is line shape.
options.case: Striking, but hairline marks are hard to hit and read with chalky hands in a bright gym.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean Material 3 fitness tracker, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Top app bar, FAB to start a session, cards of recent sessions and stats.
